Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one transparent inventory sprite for a hand-drawn 2D western saloon game.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its single object's identity, shape, silhouette, proportions, orientation, composition, parts, label placement, and item count. Input image 2 will be the STYLE REFERENCE only; transfer its quiet flat matte hand-painted 2D gouache style, not its subject or bottle shape.
Change rendering only: replace photographic shine with three or four broad low-contrast color planes, a fine softly irregular brown ink outline, and a few calm visible brush strokes. Use subdued warm natural colors. Preserve clearly readable silhouettes and large design features for a 96-pixel inventory icon. Simplify intricate veins, grains, glass reflections and woven fibers into sparse drawn marks. Soft diffuse light with very mild one-side shading, no brilliant highlights.

Background: preserve genuinely transparent alpha outside the object. No black, white, solid colored or checkerboard background painted into the image. Keep a full uncropped object with clear transparent margins. The painted object may be opaque enough to read cleanly.

Specific subject and preserved identity: Preserve the short rounded glass juice bottle, cork, pale yellow-green liquid and rectangular blank paper label with a single lime drawing. Render the juice as soft pale lime green, bottle in muted gray-green glass planes, and cork/label in matte warm tan and cream. Make the lime graphic a simple brown and green hand drawing. No extra fruit outside the bottle.
